g.text: Ingests it within ~2 minutes, files it by the
customer NIT in the XML and opens a task
Assigns one or more process leaders
Confirms the goods or service were received;
Picked by fixed supplier NIT or weighted rotation;
Approves payment; can reroute the invoice
the same bag, then goes to Causación
Petty cash: leaves the invoice flow
At any phase: return to an earlier phase · request a DIAN rejection
(Rechazos DIAN → Rechazada DIAN) · close the invoice
SLA per phase in business days (Colombian holidays);
a daily digest emails the owners of overdue invoices
